digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, context-limit escalation and sizing
propositions: models_at_or_above does not locate non-Anthropic-family primaries in the ladder and falls through to return the entire ladder instead of the primary itself
largest_window_tokens returns the ladder maximum for unlocated primaries instead of a conservative default, overstating available context
escalation for a non-Anthropic primary downgrades to a smaller-window Anthropic model and crosses provider families, violating operator intent
prerequisite-coverage escalation inherits the same defect through the same code path without direct editing of prerequisites.py
context-limit failures for unlocated primaries produce incorrect `_too_big` findings or cross into other provider families instead of retrying on the operator's model
the fix must handle three test assertions in test_model_class_ladder.py that pin the old defective behavior and need inversion to the new explicit-outcome contract
